title: Per-subscription delivery stats endpoint
objective: Add GET /subscriptions/{subscription_id}/stats returning delivery counts broken down by delivery status for that one subscription, mirroring the conventions of the existing global stats endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: GET /subscriptions/{subscription_id}/stats returns 200 with delivery counts by status scoped to that subscription only
An unknown subscription id returns 404 with body {"detail": "subscription not found"}
The response follows the same field conventions as the existing global stats response, reusing existing schema types wherever they apply rather than inventing a parallel shape
Counts must exclude deliveries belonging to other subscriptions, proven by a test that seeds two subscriptions with deliveries and asserts each one's counts independently
Tests cover the 200 path, the 404 path, and the cross-subscription isolation case
Both gates pass: `uv run ruff check .` exits 0 and `uv run pytest -q` exits 0
